notes: Round 2/iteration: seed bagging (add LGB_tuned with random_state=2024, same hyperparams) as 5th pool member, per validated recipe (cheapest residual gain after Optuna tuning in s3e1/s3e7/s3e11/s3e14). Raw OOF MAE improved marginally to 1.35533 (best raw so far) but ROUNDED OOF MAE 1.33893 is WORSE than both current best (1.33812) and round 1 (1.33850). 2nd consecutive non-improving round on the rounded decision metric -> STOP per iteration protocol. Insight: on this dataset the Optuna-tuned LGB variants cluster very close to the original LGB in OOF-space (low diversity, since only depth/lr/reg differ, same objective/features/CV), so raw-MAE gains from tuning+bagging are real but too small to survive the discrete rounding step; the untuned 3-model blend at 0.6/0.3/0.1 remains the best ROUNDED submission.

notes: Tree-search result (Phase E-3, harness v2 acid-test on ROUNDED-INTEGER MAE, 2026-07-04) — NOT a linear-iteration round. Source: experiments_tree.json (v2 harness tree), node #15 (27 nodes total, 24 evaluated, 3 failed [harmless, XGB/CAT lineages out of this evaluator's fresh-training scope], wall 1409.4s). Score above (1.33563) is the ROUNDED OOF MAE, this competition's decision metric — consistent with experiment_id=3/4's convention (top-level score = rounded, ensemble.score = raw). Beats the Kaggle-SUBMITTED linear champion (the very first entry in this file, rounded 1.33812, public/private LB 1.34356/1.34075) by -0.00249 (-0.186% relative), DESPITE this node's raw OOF MAE (1.35712) being WORSE than the champion's raw 1.35589 -- a genuine raw-vs-rounded INVERSION, independently re-verified digit-for-digit from the 8 cached member OOFs outside the search tree. This is the mirror image of experiment_id=3/4 (there: raw improved, rounded worsened; here: raw worsened, rounded improved) -- together the cleanest possible demonstration that rounded MAE, not raw OOF MAE, must be the decision metric on this comp. OOF-only — this blend was NOT submitted to Kaggle; no submission field is set (do not confuse with the real, submitted LB scores quoted above, which remain this competition's official leaderboard result).
